name: Short-crowding + oversold RSI confirm (positioning + price stretch, NOT RSI-alone)
rationale: Thesis: ordinary oversold-RSI dip-buying is exhausted — it fires on every shallow pullback. The edge is the rare oversold bar that ALSO sits on a crowded-short positioning extreme, where mechanical short-covering supplies the bounce. Entry (long-only spot): funding_rate < a deeply-negative floor [-0.005,-0.0005] AND rsi < an oversold floor. Funding is the positioning gate (crowded shorts paying longs); RSI is the price-stretch confirm. DISCONFIRMER: must beat RSI-oversold ALONE with the SAME rsi floor and no funding gate — if lone-RSI matches net Sharpe, the funding gate is decorative and this is plain RSI reversion. funding_feature is null — no carry accrued, the claim is positioning-level, not carry. Exit on RSI recovering through a fitted level OR funding normalizing back up.
catalyst: price oversold while perp funding is deeply negative (crowded shorts)
